post.description:
This endpoint allows user to submit their referred quote to an underwriter for review. Please note:

  • Bind Eligible or Declined quotes cannot be submitted for review
  • Once quote has been submitted, only the following information can edited, using the PATCH Quote Information endpoint:
    • Effective Date
    • Business Name
    • Insured Contact Information
    • Website
    • Mailing Address
    • Agent Contact
    • Agent Need By Date is optional; if it is not sent in, the date will be defaulted to two(2) business days from current date
